title: This is launch week for my free MOBA esports manager on Android 🏆
author: Early_Flamingo5337
selftext:
Hi everyone!

After months of solo development, **Gales of Gods: MOBA Manager** is having its launch week. It’s an esports manager for your phone: you don’t play the matches with your hands, you win them with your head.

* **Draft like a pro:** pick your side, then ban and pick from 100+ champions. Counters, early vs late game, teamfight vs split push all matter.
* **Fearless Bo5:** in international series every champion can only be played once, so deep champion pools win titles.
* **Live calls during the match:** fight for the drake, split push or play it safe while the game plays out on the map.
* **Run your club:** staff, academy players and progression, from the lowest division all the way to Worlds.
* **Free to play, no pay-to-win**, playable offline.

🎮 Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kronendgames.galesofgods](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kronendgames.galesofgods)

🗳️ It’s on PixelPicked for launch week. If you like it, a vote there would mean a lot to a solo dev: [https://pixelpicked.com/game/7Vl6lHV7x0n/gales-of-gods-moba-manager](https://pixelpicked.com/game/7Vl6lHV7x0n/gales-of-gods-moba-manager)

Honest feedback is very welcome, good or bad. I read every comment. Thanks for reading!

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: the fearless bo5 is the part i would want to try. does the opponent change its bans and picks in games 3 to 5 based on which champions are already gone? that could make a series feel different from five separate matches.

replies.author: Early_Flamingo5337
replies.body: Yeah of course, an they are based on what your players and their players are best with. Would love you to try it and give me some feedback on what you liked and what you missed
